change.undoHeld: Stop simulating to undo this change.
change.undoReadOnly: This tab only reads the project: undo the change in the tab that edits it.

pairing.title: Connect an AI
pairing.description: Give this code to your AI agent. It pairs with this tab through statewright mcp, running on your computer.
pairing.copyText: Pair with my Statewright Editor: call editor_pair with the code {{code}}. The Editor reaches the statewright MCP server at {{address}}; if it is not running there, start it with: {{command}}
pairing.unreachableHint: Start statewright mcp in your agent (npx statewright mcp), or type the address it gave you. The Editor keeps looking and connects by itself.
pairing.refused: The server at {{address}} does not accept this Editor.
pairing.refusedHint: Start it with --origin {{origin}}; the Editor keeps looking.
pairing.invalidHint: Type 127.0.0.1 or localhost with the port the server gives.
pairing.expired: This code expired before an agent used it.
pairing.allows: The agent reads and changes this project. Its changes appear in the history as AI, and you can undo them.
pairing.network: Your browser may ask to let this page reach your local network: allow it, so the Editor can reach the server on your computer.

handover.title: Hand over to another tab?
handover.description: {{agent}} asks to work in another Statewright tab. This tab will stop receiving its calls.

conversation.label: Conversation with {{agent}}

status.awayHint: Messages wait until it reads them

conversation.empty: Write to {{agent}}: what you select goes with your message.

notSent.old: Not sent: the AI's statewright server is older than this Editor and does not take messages. Update it (npm install -g statewright@latest), then restart the AI's session and pair again.
notSent.other: Not sent: the AI's server did not answer. Your text is back in the field; try again.

question.label: Question from {{agent}}
question.picking: Mark the elements on the canvas, then confirm.
question.failed: The answer did not reach {{agent}}: try again.

explain.label: Explain
explain.words: Explain what this does and why.

review.label: Review
review.words: Review this: Problems, gaps and inconsistencies.

fill.label: Fill in what is missing
fill.words: Fill in what is missing here: ask me what you do not know.

scenarios.label: Write scenarios
scenarios.words: Write scenarios that run through this.

detail.label: Detail in a level
detail.words: Detail this in a level of its own.

proposal.label: Proposal from {{agent}}
proposal.refusedReadOnly: This tab only reads the project: accept it in the tab that edits it.
proposal.otherProject: it was proposed for another project
proposal.forcedLocked: Proposed because it changes what is locked: {{names}}.

voice.consent: Dictation uses your browser's speech recognition: in Chrome, what you say is sent to Google's speech service to be written. Nothing is recorded or kept here.
voice.refused: The microphone was refused: allow it in the browser to dictate.
